title: Pakistani gunsmith who hammers out AKs from aircraft scrap on a granite rock
summary: Joe McMoneagle tells of Pakistani gunsmith who hammers out AKs from aircraft scrap on a granite rock, about unspecified at Pakistan, near the Afghan border, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: there's a guy that lives just cross the border in Pakistan lives in a mud hut

plain: Joe McMoneagle, a former army psychic spy who says he used remote viewing, a claimed ability to describe faraway places with the mind alone, told podcast host Jesse Michels a story he had heard. He says a man living in a mud hut just across the Afghan border in Pakistan hammers out AK rifles, a common type of assault rifle, from scrap aircraft metal on a granite rock. McMoneagle tells it as an example of how much skill can sit in an unlikely place.
